focus_summary.purpose: Stop-hook plugin that decides whether Claude should continue by running a separate Claude evaluation on recent transcript context.
key_flows: Stop hook receives event JSON on stdin
Parse transcript_path and session_id, sample recent transcript entries
Invoke claude with system prompt and JSON schema
Apply throttling rules and emit decision JSON
constraints: Hook input/output contract must remain stable
Cross-platform compatibility via run-hook.cmd and bash
No new runtime dependencies beyond bash, jq, and claude CLI
Behavioral parity required for existing eval scenarios
risks_or_unknowns: Prompt edits can shift classification behavior
LLM evaluation is non-deterministic across runs
Windows Git Bash path resolution may differ
Path drift between hooks and tests can hide failures

work_items.title: Hook entrypoints and event parsing hardening

content.summary: Stabilize hook entrypoints, pathing, and event parsing to remove brittle coupling.
content.problem: Path drift and repeated parsing create fragile behavior and complicate debugging.
success_criteria: Paths are centralized and consistent across hooks and tests
Event parsing is single-pass and validated
content.notes: Keep behavior identical and avoid new dependencies.

content.summary: Make prompt logic and decision flow easier to evolve without behavior drift.
content.problem: Large inline prompt and opaque decision flow make changes risky and hard to validate.
success_criteria: Prompt updates are versioned and testable
Decision trace is optional and non-invasive
No behavior changes in existing evals
content.notes: Maintain the hook contract and keep default behavior identical.

content.summary: Improve test harness reliability and reduce duplication across scripts.
content.problem: Eval scripts duplicate logic and lack schema validation, making tests brittle.
content.notes: Keep test output stable where possible.

work_items.title: Normalize hook script paths and root resolution across hooks/tests

content.summary: Create a single source-of-truth for the hook script path and use it in hooks and tests.
content.current_state: Tests reference a scripts/ path while the hook script lives in hooks/, and path resolution is duplicated in multiple scripts.
expected_improvements: Reduces brittle coupling between hooks and tests
implementation_steps: Identify all hook script path references in hooks and tests
Introduce a shared path definition (env var or sourced helper)
Update hooks/hooks.json and test scripts to use the shared path
Verify run-hook.cmd remains cross-platform compatible
acceptance_criteria: - [ ] Hook and tests resolve the same script path
- [ ] Hook output schema unchanged (no behavior changes)
- [ ] Existing eval scenarios pass with identical decisions
content.risk_mitigation: Keep a fallback to the current path during refactor and compare eval outputs before and after.

work_items.title: Consolidate hook event parsing and validation into a single jq pass

content.summary: Parse event fields once with validation and defaults to reduce repeated jq calls.
content.current_state: The hook uses multiple jq invocations on the same event JSON without schema validation, increasing fragility.
implementation_steps: Define required fields and defaults for event JSON
Use a single jq query to emit a tab-separated tuple
Parse the tuple with read and validate each field
Keep fallback behavior identical to current defaults
acceptance_criteria: - [ ] Missing fields default exactly as before (no behavior changes)
- [ ] Hook output schema unchanged
- [ ] Existing eval scenarios pass with identical decisions
content.risk_mitigation: Add guardrails for empty or invalid fields and retain the current early-exit approvals.

work_items.title: Add scenario schema validation and normalization in eval runner

content.summary: Validate scenario files before running evals and normalize transcripts to a consistent schema.
content.current_state: Scenarios are not schema-validated, so malformed files fail late and with unclear errors.
implementation_steps: Define required scenario fields and constraints
Add a validation step at the start of run-evals.sh
Normalize transcript entries to strict role/content pairs
Fail fast with actionable error messages
acceptance_criteria: - [ ] Invalid scenario files fail fast with a clear message
- [ ] Valid scenarios run unchanged (no behavior changes)
- [ ] Existing eval scenarios pass with identical decisions
test_plan: Add one intentionally invalid scenario locally to confirm validation (do not commit)
content.risk_mitigation: Ensure validation only rejects truly invalid inputs and keep normalization conservative.

work_items.title: Reduce hook process spawning and redundant reads

content.summary: Batch jq reads and throttle parsing to reduce subprocess overhead in the hook.
content.current_state: The hook spawns multiple jq and cut processes for the same inputs and reads the throttle file multiple times.
implementation_steps: Parse throttle file once using IFS and read
Combine jq reads into fewer passes
Cache computed values (e.g., time since last) in variables
Keep all decisions and defaults identical
acceptance_criteria: - [ ] Hook decisions unchanged (no behavior changes)
- [ ] No additional subprocesses added
- [ ] Existing eval scenarios pass with identical decisions
content.risk_mitigation: Keep intermediate values explicit and add guards for missing throttle data.

work_items.title: Introduce shared bash helper library for hooks/tests

content.summary: Create a shared bash helper file for path resolution, temp handling, and logging.
content.current_state: Scripts duplicate setup, temp dir handling, and JSON assembly logic.
implementation_steps: Identify shared patterns across hook and test scripts
Create hooks/lib/common.sh with focused helpers
Source the helper from scripts that need it
Keep helpers small and single-purpose
acceptance_criteria: - [ ] Shared helpers replace duplicated logic
- [ ] No behavior changes in hook output
- [ ] Existing eval scenarios pass with identical decisions
content.risk_mitigation: Scope helpers narrowly and avoid global side effects.

work_items.title: Externalize evaluation prompt and schema into versioned templates

content.summary: Move prompt and schema text to dedicated files and add a light snapshot check.
content.current_state: Prompt and schema are inlined in the hook script, making edits error-prone and hard to review.
expected_improvements: Clear separation of prompt content from control flow
Lower risk of accidental prompt edits
implementation_steps: Create prompt and schema files under hooks/prompts
Load prompt content and schema into the hook at runtime
Add a small snapshot comparison in tests or a lint step
Document prompt versioning expectations
acceptance_criteria: - [ ] Prompt content loaded from files without changing decisions
- [ ] Hook output schema unchanged (no behavior changes)
- [ ] Existing eval scenarios pass with identical decisions
content.risk_mitigation: Keep the inline prompt as a short-term fallback until file loading is stable.

experiment.small_experiment: Extract the prompt to a file and run three representative scenarios to compare decisions.
experiment.success_metric: No decision diffs in the sample scenarios and prompt file loads correctly.
experiment.rollback_plan: Revert to the inline prompt and delete the prompt files.

work_items.title: Add optional structured decision tracing for debug workflows

content.summary: Introduce an opt-in debug trace that records decision flow without changing default output.
content.current_state: Only a final reason string is emitted, which makes it hard to diagnose classification issues.
implementation_steps: Add a DEBUG_TRACE flag and trace helper
Record key checkpoints (inputs, throttle state, prompt result)
Emit trace to stderr or a temp file when enabled
Ensure no trace output in default mode
acceptance_criteria: - [ ] Default output remains unchanged (no behavior changes)
- [ ] Trace output only appears when DEBUG_TRACE is set
- [ ] Existing eval scenarios pass with identical decisions
test_plan: Run a single scenario with DEBUG_TRACE=1 to verify trace output
content.risk_mitigation: Keep trace strictly opt-in and avoid adding stdout noise.

experiment.small_experiment: Add a minimal trace for one scenario and confirm stdout is unchanged.
experiment.success_metric: Trace appears only with DEBUG_TRACE=1 and decisions are identical.
experiment.rollback_plan: Remove trace logic and DEBUG_TRACE flag.

work_items.title: Split hook into a pure decision engine and IO wrapper

content.summary: Separate pure decision logic from IO so it can be tested and reasoned about independently.
content.current_state: The hook mixes IO, throttling, prompt construction, and decision output in a single script.
implementation_steps: Define a decision-engine interface that accepts parsed inputs
Extract decision logic into a new script or function
Keep current hook as a thin wrapper over the engine
Add a deterministic CLI harness for the engine
Maintain existing eval runner behavior
acceptance_criteria: - [ ] Hook output remains identical (no behavior changes)
- [ ] Engine and wrapper are covered by existing eval scenarios
- [ ] Existing eval scenarios pass with identical decisions
content.risk_mitigation: Introduce the engine behind a flag and keep the monolith as a fallback during migration.

experiment.small_experiment: Extract a minimal engine that returns a decision for one scenario and compare output.
experiment.success_metric: Engine output matches current hook decision for sample scenarios.
experiment.rollback_plan: Disable the engine path and keep the current monolithic script.
